title: Strength Training
description: Build strength, confidence, and proper technique in this focused, small group training class. With coaching from a certified personal trainer and a supportive team environment, you’ll learn how to safely and effectively workout. REC/IM MEMEBERSHIP REQUIRE

title: Butts & Guts
description: This high energy class will leave you feeling accomplished! One of our fitness instructors will lead you through a variety of lower body and core exercises that will strengthen and sculpt your body. REC/IM MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED.

title: Graduate Colloquium
description: A celebration of music graduate student work, this event will feature performances and research presentations by EMU Master of Music students. Free and open to the public.  A reception will follow.

title: Cycle 45
description: A high energy cardio workout that works the body using various resistance and speed levels. This class offers an intense cardio blast on the bikes simulating a real life road course up and down hills and through speed intervals! REC/IM MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED

title: Sculpt Pilates
description: This dynamic Pilates based strength class blends traditional core focused movements with controlled sculpting exercises to tone and strengthen the entire body. Using light weights, resistance bands, and bodyweight training! REC/IM MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED

title: Occupational Therapy Zoom Group Advising Session
description: Come join our Zoom session to learn more about the occupational therapy program and how to apply. Email ot_intent_advising@emich.edu to RSVP. To join via Zoom, please use the link below and Meeting ID: 859 513

title: Connect the Feeling with the Notation of Music Using Laban's Effort Actions
description: Judith Barthwell-Thompson, veteran educator and Orff-Schulwerk leader, brings music to life through movement. Open to all — music or dance, major or minor —her  playful workshop uses Laban’s Effort Actions to connect analysis, feeling, and expression!

title: Honors Undergraduate Research Workshop
description: The Undergraduate Research Workshop is designed to encourage Honors students to participate in research and to help them do so. Attendance at one of these workshops is required for graduation for ALL of the Honors pathways.

title: Rock the Patio
description: Celebrate another glorious end to the year with free food, music, games, and more!

title: Cap & Gown Countdown
description: Join us for Cap & Gown Countdown — the ultimate kickoff to graduation! This signature event celebrates your accomplishments and helps you get ready for commencement in style.

title: BSN Information Session
description: The Eastern Michigan University School of Nursing is pleased to share the dates for our upcoming BSN Information Sessions designed for those interested in future admission.

title: Senior Recital: Alannis Barber, Cello
description: Music Education candidate and cellist Alannis Barber in collaboration with pianists Ben Luczak and Leah Fox presents their senior recital! The program will feature works by Sulkhan Tsintsadze, Prokofiev, Bach, and Lei Liang.

title: Learn to Lift
description: This program is aimed at beginners who are interested in starting out at the gym and want some guidance and information on how to get started. Join this program for guided experience in Gym Etiquette, Strength, and Workouts! REC/IM MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED

title: Honors College Book Club Meeting
venue: Honors College - Lower Level Lounge (Commuter Lounge)
description: The Honors College Book Club is excited to meet again every other Tuesday night from 6:30-7:30pm in the Lower Level Lounge in the Honors College! Whether you are in the Honors College or not, we encourage you to join! More information will be posted soon

description: The EMU Jazz Ensemble will feature New Orleans jazz artist Rev Paulin along with special guests Lincoln High School Jazz Ensemble. Presale tickets are $12 adult/$10 student or $15 at the door. https://emich.ludus.com/200519081

description: Join the Honors College for one last hurrah before finals! We will have pancakes, a karaoke room (w/colorful disco lights), bingo, coloring pages, and more! Stop by for dinner, a space to hang out with friends, and make some memories before summer break!
